name: Pentesireiya Sandra
original_name: ペンテシレイヤ・サンドラ
source:
She was raised as a pirate for as long as she could remember, and is a one-eyed swordswoman who travels the world's oceans as the Captain of the Poseidon Pirates. She has the telepathic ability to move objects without using her hands, and combines that power with her giant sword.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071215205316fw_/http://www.mink.co.jp/lineup/da/char04.html]Mink[/url]]
